~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE "BAYTOWNE BEACH N BIRDIE" ~
• Elegant & Luxurious Baytowne Golf Course Home
• 6-Seat & 4-Seat Golf Carts
• Heated Resort Pool & access to 2 other non heated pools
• 100 feet from non-heated community pool
• 1 miles from the Baytowne Wharf
• Can take the golf cart to the beach, to Publix grocery store, and to Grand Boulevard Shopping Center.
• Resort has private beach access
• Less than 1 mile from 2 gas stations & Gulf Place town square full of restaurants and shops
• 5 minutes to Grand Boulevard outdoor shopping center full of great stores, restaurants and a movie theater
• 6 minutes to Silver Sands Outlet Mall in Miramar Beach

~ THE SPACE ~
Welcome to your ultimate vacation sanctuary at "Baytowne Beach N Birdie", where luxury meets leisure and every detail is crafted with your utmost comfort in mind. This stunning two-story retreat is more than just a rental—it's a gateway to a truly extraordinary experience. With TWO GOLF CARTS at your disposal—a 4-seat and a 6-seat—your adventures will be as convenient as they are exhilarating.

Step inside "Baytowne Beach N Birdie" and be greeted by a spacious and beautifully designed interior with special touches at every turn. Whether you're traveling with your family or simply seeking a beachside escape, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom is tailored to exceed your expectations. From the exquisite furnishings to the amenities, every aspect of this home has been curated to elevate your stay to new heights. With a fully stocked kitchen, enjoying dinners at home will be a breeze. The custom 8-seat dining table along with the 3 phenomenal Restoration Hardware barstools offer plenty of seating for the entire family. Pottery Barn and Restoration Hardware furniture adorn the living area. The large flat screen smart TV makes movies night after the beach easily enjoyable due to the thoughtful, heavy duty, black out, stylized plantation shutters.

With its versatile layout spanning two floors, this home offers ample space for relaxation and entertainment. A cozy guest room featuring a full over full bunk bed is located on the first floor, just down the hall from the guest bath. Venture upstairs to discover three additional bedrooms. The vast master king suite with coffered ceiling, flat screen smart tv, and private bath will be your oasis. The offers a dual sink vanity, a spa style soaking tub, separate custom shower with glass enclosure and private water closet. Two additional guest suites boasting private bathrooms including 1 queen room and 1 king room, will ensure that everyone at "Baytowne Beach N Birdie" will enjoy comfort and privacy.

Sandestin Beach Access Update – Effective May 1, 2025, Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort has implemented a paid parking policy for all vehicles, including golf carts, at the resort's beach access point. The daily parking fee is $20, and guests will pay Sandestin directly for parking.

~ THE AREA ~
Sandestin Resort is an amazing vacation spot! Its family friendly atmosphere will keep you coming back for years. Baytowne Wharf is a beautiful pedestrian outdoor plaza with retail stores and restaurants overlooking the bay. For child friendly fun visit the Baytowne BlastArcade & Laser Maze or head to the Baytowne Adventure Zone to zip across the lagoon on the Baytowne Zipline or try your skills on the Sky Trail Ropes aerial obstacle course. If they still haven't had enough fun, the Tower Climb and Eurobungy are attractions sure to thrill them. Smaller children will be delighted to explore the Baytowne Adventure Landing Playground. Relax while the kids play on this imaginative nautical themed playground with slides and towers galore. This is a large enclosed fenced area, where kids can climb, swing, run and play to their hearts content.

Sandestin has many other exciting things to offer. Take a trip to the Marina and eat lunch on the water while watching the Yachts and Sailboats explore the bay. La Dolce Vita at the Marina offers pontoon and Jet Ski rentals for hours of family fun. Sandestin also features amazing golf courses, tennis courts, a SPA and a Fitness Center for additional fees. Sandestin is golf cart friendly! That means you can take the golf cart anywhere in Sandestin and even to the Grand Boulevard Plaza.

Explore Grand Boulevard for exclusive boutiques, renowned retailers, specialty shops and mouthwatering culinary creations from an array of casual and fine dining restaurant including Tommy Bahamas, Vin'tij, Grimaldi's, Cantina Laredo and Fleming's Steakhouse. Grand Boulevard features live entertainment, exciting outdoor events and a 10-screen movie theater.

description:
Located in Villa Lago, a neighborhood in Miramar Beach, this vacation home is next to a golf course and on the beach. While the natural beauty of Miramar Beach and Destin Beaches can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
